target.outcome_description: A fair six-sided die roll is 5 or 6

forecast.horizon: One synthetic die roll, resolving by the stated deadline

resolution_rule.rule: Resolve true if the recorded result is 5 or 6; otherwise false
resolution_rule.missing_or_holiday_policy: If no roll is recorded, leave unresolved; do not infer an outcome

comparator.description: No empirical or market comparator; this is a schema illustration only
comparator.limitations: Do not treat this example as a financial forecast

forecast.rationale: In a fair six-sided die model, two of six equally likely outcomes satisfy the event definition. This toy example demonstrates a binary probability record; it is not market analysis.
forecast.disconfirming_evidence: A resolved roll of 1, 2, 3, or 4 is a non-event; repeated fair rolls would be needed to evaluate calibration.
